data.gender_notes: Aziman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aziman translates to 'the powerful one' or 'the majestic one'. Derived from the root 'azamah', it signifies strength, might, and grandeur. The name Aziman carries the meaning “Majestic, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aziman usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In Islamic history, there have been numerous commanders, soldiers, and leaders who bore this name, popular among the masses for its resonating meaning. It embodies the spirit of resilience and determination often demonstrated by Muslims throughout history when faced with adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name Aziman holds profound spiritual significance. For Muslims, it is a reminder of the Almighty God as the most powerful and majestic being. His capacity to bring the universe into existence and sustain it is limitless. The name encourages individuals to gain strength from their faith and strive towards becoming vessels of Allah's greatness. Embodying the name Aziman means internalizing the noble qualities of power, wisdom, and righteousness that God bestows upon His chosen servants.
